title: Modular Monolith Architecture for Game Deals Tracking
context: Building a reliable price tracking system for 300-600 games with periodic sync and public web presentation.
decision: Adopt a single-repository Modular Monolith built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL.
consequences: Single codebase for web and background worker
risks: Monolith components must maintain strict module isolation to avoid tight coupling.
